EmbeddingsInferenceReceipt.description: Additive inference evidence; never a substitute for operator policy.
EmbeddingsInferenceReceipt.title: EmbeddingsInferenceReceipt

EmbeddingsOperatorPolicy.description:
Persisted operator embeddings policy (implementation note E1).

Distinct from ``embeddings_mode``, which remains the install receipt.
``policy_revision`` is monotonic. ``origin`` records how the policy
was chosen; omitted history cannot be recovered as explicit intent.
EmbeddingsOperatorPolicy.title: EmbeddingsOperatorPolicy

OverlayConfigEntry.description:
A consumer-tool config that bootstrap wrote (e.g. .vscode/mcp.json).

``action`` is the string the install flow emits today
(``created``, ``updated``, ``set``, ``unchanged``). Modeled as a
free string rather than a Literal so the contract does not block
bootstrap from introducing new actions before the protocol bumps.

action.description: What bootstrap did to the config (e.g. 'created', 'updated', 'set', 'unchanged').
action.title: Action

OverlayConfigEntry.title: OverlayConfigEntry

OverlaySurface.description: A single overlay surface entry (e.g. skills, commands, hooks).

source.description: Origin tier: 'shared' (symlinked from workbay-system), 'local' (target-owned), 'overlapping' (target overrides shared), 'generated' (per-agent surface produced by generate_agent_workflows.py during install — implementation note step 1), 'lifecycle' (implementation note hoisted Make fragment + runner package — copied, not symlinked, so the consumer can run `make context` without the workbay-system packaging tree).
source.title: Source

OverlaySurface.title: OverlaySurface

StackSource.description:
Install-ledger source provenance for the package stack.

``resolved_from`` is required. ``ref`` / ``sha`` are recorded only when
known: an unattested git claim (``{"resolved_from": "git"}``) is a legal
derive-path output and must round-trip.

ref.description: Requested revision (git) or source URL (local) when known.
ref.title: Ref

resolved_from.description: How the stack packages were resolved: a git checkout, a local file:// install, or an unresolvable/index source.
resolved_from.title: Resolved From

sha.description: Resolved 40-char git commit id when known.
sha.title: Sha

StackSource.title: StackSource

description:
Top-level shape of ``.workbay-overlay.json``.

Validated on write by ``workbay-bootstrap.install`` so the file
cannot drift silently. Consumers (drift detectors, doctor commands)
parse the same model on read.

codemap_mode.description: Codemap-first source-discovery policy recorded at install time. 'enforced' refuses source discovery in favor of codemap; 'available' allows with an advisory; 'off' allows. None when omitted from an older ledger — omission is not explicit available or off. Typed reads live in capability_mode.
codemap_mode.title: Codemap Mode

embeddings_inference_receipt.description: Additive current-inference receipt (model identity, digests, probe). Absent until real verification evidence exists; enable must not manufacture this field.

embeddings_mode.description: Semantic-embeddings capability recorded at install time. 'verified' (install --with-embeddings) means the [embeddings] extra and digest pin were hard-verified at install, so semantic features may rely on them; 'disabled' (install --no-embeddings) means the operator opted out; 'unspecified' — the default, and the value assumed when the field is absent from an older manifest — preserves best-effort provisioning behavior. Historical 'verified' is a provisioning receipt, not a promise of current inference.
embeddings_mode.title: Embeddings Mode

embeddings_operator_policy.description: Operator embeddings/reinjection policy (implementation note E1). None when an older ledger has not been migrated. Distinct from embeddings_mode, which remains the install receipt enum.

execution_mode.description: Offload execution policy recorded at install time. 'remote_only' (install --with-remote) declares that subagent implementation work must dispatch to the remote gate backend; 'local_ok' — the default, and the value assumed when the field is absent from an older manifest — keeps local offload allowed.
execution_mode.title: Execution Mode

mcp_servers.description: Sorted list of managed MCP server names bootstrap last wrote into ``.mcp.json`` / ``.vscode/mcp.json`` / ``.codex/config.toml``. Read by ``sync_mcp_configs(prune_removed_managed=True)`` as the authoritative previously-managed provenance so third-party launchers in those files are preserved across syncs.
mcp_servers.title: Mcp Servers

plugin_overrides_path.description: Optional explicit plugin override root recorded by bootstrap so later doctor/update/repair runs can reuse a non-default internal override location.
plugin_overrides_path.title: Plugin Overrides Path

remote_sha.description: Resolved 40-char git SHA at install time (git_overlay source).
remote_sha.title: Remote Sha

source_kind.description: Overlay delivery source: 'git_overlay' (a clone checked out at remote_ref), 'package' (an installed workbay-system distribution), or 'worktree' (the repo's own working tree / HEAD). Defaults to 'git_overlay' so manifests written before internal validate unchanged.
source_kind.title: Source Kind

stack_distribution.description: Meta-package anchor distribution recorded by package-source install/update when it is installed (implementation note: 'workbay'). None for legacy/pre-stack installs.
stack_distribution.title: Stack Distribution

stack_members.description: Mapping of stack member distribution name -> exact version pinned by the installed anchor's metadata. Doctor compares the live environment against this expectation (stack_drift).
stack_members.title: Stack Members

stack_source.description: Source provenance for the package stack (requested ref, resolved SHA, and how it was obtained) so 'is this really vX.Y.Z?' is answerable from the ledger. None for git_overlay/worktree installs and for older package manifests that predate the field.

stack_version.description: Installed version of the stack anchor distribution at install/update time (package source only).
stack_version.title: Stack Version
